A members' club for people who travel

Together Travel Club is where you meet people with travel plans like yours. Whatever you're into, or want to try, you can connect with others travelling to the same place as you, planned trip or not.

Connecting

How it comes together.

Four steps take you from signing up to messaging your next travel companion.

Step 1

Tell us about you

Add your interests, travel style, and where you're travelling to, or just where you'd like to go. It only takes a couple of minutes to get started.

Step 2

We find your people

We connect you with members travelling to a similar place, or who travel in a similar way to you, whether solo, as a couple, or with friends.

Step 3

Everyone is verified

Every member is checked before they can connect with you, so you always know who you're talking to.

Step 4

Message, then meet

Chat as much as you like before you set off, and meet up in person before your trip if you'd both like to.

Sign up

Join the founding community.

Start with the basics — it takes a minute. Once you're in, we'll walk you through your interests and the rest of your profile, which is what sharpens your shortlist.

Thank you, you've been added to the founding list. Please note that this demo form doesn't send your details anywhere yet.
This is a prototype only, so the form isn't yet connected to an email system or a CRM. Please don't collect any ID documents on this page; once verification is built, that should run through a specialist verification provider instead.

Your profile, built up over time

Nothing here is required to sign up — but the more you fill in afterwards, the more precise your shortlist becomes.

1
Your interests, so we can start shortlisting who you'd get on with
2
Travel style, covering your budget, pace, board basis and how you like to plan a trip
3
Your next trip, along with any other destinations you're considering
You don't have to complete these extra steps to start connecting with other members, but each one gives us a little more to work with, so the more you fill in, the more precise your shortlist becomes.
